settings.heading: The City's finest wine shop
settings.text: Welcome to St Swithins Wine Shippers, a destination for wine enthusiasts on historic St Swithin's Lane — Enomatics, Coravin, and an all-weather tasting terrace a stone's throw from the Bank of England.

settings.heading: The cellar & terrace
settings.text: Wine by the glass, bottles to take home, and a terrace for lingering. Photographed at St Swithins in the City.

settings.quote: Our host Fred was superb. He knows his wines and provided a 5 star service throughout our stay. Would highly recommend for an enjoyable experience.
settings.author: Gary Grant

settings.quote: Ludo, Alpesh and Fred were fantastic — quick, professional service. They know their wines inside out and the atmosphere is superb.
settings.author: Jon Doe

settings.quote: Best wines based on our taste — no guessing. Booking my future visits already. Thank you!
settings.author: Christine

settings.quote: A beautiful cellar experience with thoughtful recommendations. Every bottle we took home was outstanding.
settings.author: Sarah Mitchell

settings.quote: From tasting to shipping, everything felt personal and carefully handled. We'll be back for the next vintage.
settings.author: David & Emma
